definitions.gloss: triple time; waltz time; three-beat rhythm
definitions.explanation: A musical time signature with three beats per measure, as in a waltz.

definitions.gloss: three essential qualities; the complete package
definitions.explanation: Used figuratively to describe three important qualities that together make something or someone ideal. Most commonly appears in the expression {三拍子|さんびょうし}{揃|そろ}う (all three qualities are present).

examples.japanese: ワルツ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三拍子|さんびょうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧だ。
examples.english: A waltz is a piece in triple time.

examples.japanese: {三拍子|さんびょうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リズム→リズム：04746_rizumu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{踊|おど}る→踊る：01250_odoru⟧。
examples.english: To dance to a triple-time rhythm.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三拍子|さんびょうし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}かれている→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れ→揺れ：16137_yure⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This piece is written in triple time, so it has a distinctive swaying quality.

examples.japanese: {三拍子|さんびょうし}⟦{揃|そろ}った→揃う：01953_sorou⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧だ。
examples.english: An athlete who has the complete package.

examples.japanese: ⟦{速|はや}さ→速さ：28072_hayasa⟧、⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧、⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{三拍子|さんびょうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{揃|そろ}っている→揃う：01953_sorou⟧。
examples.english: Speed, power, and technique — all three qualities are present.

examples.japanese: ⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧、⟦{見|み}た{目|め}→見た目：14110_mitame⟧、⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{三拍子|さんびょうし}⟦{揃|そろ}った→揃う：01953_sorou⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I found a restaurant that has the full package of taste, appearance, and price.

notes:
Has both a literal musical meaning and a widely used figurative meaning referring to three ideal qualities.

SENSE 2 — FIGURATIVE:
The key expression is {三拍子|さんびょうし}⟦{揃|そろ}う→揃う：01953_sorou⟧ (to have all three qualities aligned). This is used as high praise, meaning someone or something excels in three key areas simultaneously. The three qualities vary by context but are typically stated or implied.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {三拍子|さんびょうし}⟦{揃|そろ}う→揃う：01953_sorou⟧: to have all three qualities
- {三拍子|さんびょうし}⟦{揃|そろ}った→揃う：01953_sorou⟧: having the complete package
- {三拍子|さんびょうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リズム→リズム：04746_rizumu⟧: triple-time rhythm

FORMS:
⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧ (three) + {拍子|びょうし} (beat, rhythm)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {四拍子|よんびょうし}: quadruple time — musical only, no figurative use
- {拍子|びょうし}: beat, rhythm — the base word
